Half an oil drum hammered flat into a pan of thick black grease. Zombies that walk through it are Tarred for 12 seconds: 35% slower, and any fire turns them into an Inferno, triple the burn, spreading to other tarred zombies within 3 m.

Load it with animal fat from its radial menu: it holds 10, and each fat greases 4 zombies.

Upgrades at level 3: Deep Grease (55% slower) or Volatile Grease (its Infernos burn 50% hotter).

It levels up at 25, 75, 150 and 300 kills: its statuses last 10% longer and it works 5% faster per level. No power needed.

A holed 55-gallon drum on cinder blocks. Light it from its radial menu: it burns a piece of wood every 20 seconds and lights up the area at night. Zombies within 1.5 m catch fire for 8 seconds. Tarred zombies go up as an Inferno; soaked ones won't light.

Load it with wood (it holds 30). It goes out when the wood runs out.

Upgrades at level 3: Bellows (2 m reach) or Slow Burn (wood lasts 3 times longer).

It levels up at 25, 75, 150 and 300 kills: +8% damage and 5% faster per level. No power needed.

A spiked log hung from an A-frame, pulled back and held by a tripwire. When a zombie walks in front of it, the log swings through for 35 damage and knocks every zombie in its path back 3 m, then takes 5 seconds to haul back up. Frozen zombies take double damage from it.

Every swing wears it a little; repair it when it stops.

Upgrades at level 3: Spiked Log (+50% damage) or Battering Log (6 m knockback, wider swing).

It levels up at 25, 75, 150 and 300 kills: +8% damage and 5% faster per level. No power needed. Two blocks tall.

A rusty steel jaw trap. It snaps shut on the first zombie to step on it: 50 damage, and the zombie is held in place for 3 seconds (1 second for big zombies). Then it stays sprung until you re-arm it from its radial menu.

Upgrades at level 3: Spring Loader (re-arms itself after 15 seconds) or Heavy Jaws (holds for 5 seconds, big zombies too).

It levels up at 25, 75, 150 and 300 kills: +8% damage and 5% faster per level. No power needed.

A hunting bow lashed to a sawhorse. Every 3 seconds it shoots an arrow at the first zombie in a line straight ahead, up to 12 m. It fires the arrows you load into it from its radial menu (it holds 30): stone, iron, steel, flaming and exploding arrows all work like they do from a bow.

Upgrades at level 3: Repeater (every 1.5 seconds) or Long Draw (+50% damage, 20 m).

It levels up at 25, 75, 150 and 300 kills: +8% damage and 5% faster per level. No power needed.

A salvaged high-voltage coil built on a pole transformer. When powered, it zaps the nearest zombie within 8 m every 1.5 seconds for 22 damage, and the arc jumps to 2 more zombies within 4 m of each other at 60% damage per jump. Each zombie hit has a 10% chance to be jolted to a stop for a moment. It needs a clear path to its first target, but zombies in the way still conduct.

Soaked zombies (from a Sprinkler) take double damage, the arc jumps one zombie further, and a jolt on them becomes a 2-second stun.

Every zap wears the coil a little. When its lamp blinks it is worn out and stops until repaired.

Upgrades at level 3: Storm (2 more jumps, 20% less damage) or Overload (no jumps, 2.5 times the damage, and every hit stuns).

It levels up at 25, 75, 150 and 300 kills: +8% damage and 5% faster per level. Needs 30 W.

A blue water drum on cinder blocks with a little pump and a pipe rig of brass nozzles. When powered, it sprays a 6 m cone ahead of it once a second, soaking every zombie the water can reach for 10 seconds. It only sprays when a zombie is in front of it.

Soaked zombies are 15% slower and can't catch fire. A Tesla Coil does double damage to them, jumps one zombie further, and its jolt becomes a 2-second stun.

The nozzles face the way the block is placed; turn it to aim.

Upgrades at level 3: Deluge (a 90 degree cone, soaking for 20 seconds) or Pressure Washer (a narrow jet that shoves zombies back 1 m for 15 damage).

It levels up at 25, 75, 150 and 300 kills: its statuses last 10% longer and it works 5% faster per level. Needs 5 W.

A paint-sprayer gun on a swivel and a bucket of tar on a hand truck. Every 2 seconds it lobs a glob of tar at the nearest zombie within 10 m: 5 damage, and every zombie within 2 m of the splash is Tarred for 12 seconds (35% slower, and fire turns it into an Inferno).

Load it with tar (it holds 40; one tar is 4 globs). Tar is made at a workbench from oil and coal.

Upgrades at level 3: Sticky Tar (60% slower) or Volatile Tar (Infernos burn 50% hotter and spread 5 m).

It levels up at 25, 75, 150 and 300 kills: its statuses last 10% longer and it works 5% faster per level. Needs 5 W.

A rusty bin with a funnel and an alternator magnet. Every zombie your traps kill within 10 m drops 1 to 3 scrap iron into it, and sometimes brass. Only the nearest hopper gets each haul. Open it to collect.

Upgrades at level 3: Ammo Press (each haul is pressed into ammo for the emptiest trap nearby that uses ammo or fuel) or Scavenger (sometimes food, medicine or gun parts as well).

It levels up from its hauls. No power needed.

A frosty steel grate over fridge coils, laid in the floor. Every 1.5 seconds each zombie standing on it takes 6 cold damage and a Chilled stack for 4 seconds, 20% slower per stack. Three stacks freeze it solid for 2 seconds (then it can't freeze again for 6), and frozen zombies take double damage from blunt and crushing hits: the Ram, the Swinging Log, clubs and sledgehammers. Big zombies never freeze.

Every pulse wears it a little.

Upgrades at level 3: Deep Freeze (freezes at 2 stacks, for 3 seconds) or Frost Field (a 2.5 m ice patch, and the chill lasts 5 seconds longer).

It levels up at 25, 75, 150 and 300 kills: its statuses last 10% longer and it works 5% faster per level. Needs 20 W.

A log-splitter ram on a skid with a road sign for a striking plate. Every 2 seconds, if a zombie is within 2 m in front of it, it punches every zombie there for 60 damage and knocks them back 4 m. Frozen zombies take double damage from it.

Every punch wears it a little.

Upgrades at level 3: Piledriver (double damage, no knockback) or Battering Ram (8 m knockback, reaching 3 m).

It levels up at 25, 75, 150 and 300 kills: +8% damage and 5% faster per level. Needs 15 W.

The flamethrower trap the old world never finished, finished. While a zombie is in its 5 m cone it fires, burning a gas can a second: 15 damage a second, and it sets zombies on fire. Tarred zombies go up as an Inferno; soaked ones won't light.

Load it with gas cans (it holds 500).

Upgrades at level 3: Napalm (the fire stays on the ground for 4 seconds) or Blowtorch (a 10 m jet, 1.5 times the damage).

It levels up at 25, 75, 150 and 300 kills: +8% damage and 5% faster per level. Needs 10 W.

Car batteries and a capacitor bank in a shopping cart. While powered, the powered traps from this mod within 5 m attack 25% faster but wear 25% faster too. Overchargers don't stack: the strongest in range counts.

Upgrades at level 3: Capacitor Bank (8 m) or Surge (+50% speed, double wear).

It levels up from the kills of the traps it boosts. Needs 40 W.

A ballista built from a car leaf spring and a winch. Every 3 seconds it shoots a rebar bolt at the zombie with the most health within 30 m: 800 damage and a knockdown. Made for demolishers and other big zombies.

Load it with rebar bolts (it holds 20), made at a workbench.

Upgrades at level 3: Skewer (the bolt goes through up to 3 zombies) or Explosive Bolts (a 3 m blast for 150 that doesn't damage blocks).

It levels up at 25, 75, 150 and 300 kills: +8% damage and 5% faster per level. Needs 15 W.
Thick, sticky tar cooked from oil and coal. Load it into a Tar Sprayer: one tar is four globs.
